articles.title: An Eighth 'Transformers' Movie Is in the Works, With Steven Spielberg Helping Lead
articles.summary: Paramount is developing a new Transformers movie that aims to return to the spirit of the original films, with Steven Spielberg as an executive producer.

articles.title: Sam Smith Laughs About a Colorful Mix-Up in New Album Title 'Hazel Eyes'
articles.summary: Singer Sam Smith told Jimmy Fallon they named their new album 'Hazel Eyes' thinking hazel meant brown, then learned hazel eyes are a mix of colors.

articles.title: Runner Says Sorry After Riding on a Bike During the Berlin Marathon
articles.summary: A Chinese fitness influencer apologized and lost a sponsor after photos showed her riding on the back of a bike during the Sept. 27 Berlin Marathon.
